selection.algorithm: per-stratum: sort candidates by sha256(f'{seed}:{prompt_id}'), take the lowest `quota` keys, then sort the result by prompt_id
selection.allocation_rule: proportional to population fraction, largest remainder, ties broken by stratum index
selection.replacement: without replacement; no prompt_id appears twice
selection.why_hash_not_rng: NumPy does not guarantee Generator stream stability across releases; a hash key reproduces on any runtime, forever.
